description: Provide consultation and assistance for all employee benefits.

Perform leave audits.
Provide programmatic support to employees and supervisors for the on-line leave reporting system.

matchmaking_summary: The candidate has extensive experience in Human Resources, particularly in benefits and leave coordination. Their detailed-oriented approach and strong communication skills make them a valuable asset to any team. The ability to interpret and apply policies, coupled with their training abilities, highlight their expertise in HR practices. Additionally, their proficiency in all Microsoft applications and familiarity with HRIS systems such as Banner, PeopleAdmin, PMIS System, and BES demonstrates their technical capabilities within the field.
